| Metric | Target |
|---|---|

## Investments

|---|---|---|

- Written order confirmation and PO acknowledgement from Highland Paws
- Revisit margin and MOQ at the first sell-through review on 2026-12-13

# Joint Business Plan: Highland Paws x our platform

## Overview
Highland Paws launches 7 shortlisted SKUs on our platform. Terms below are from the application.

## Targets
| Metric | Target |
|---|---|
| Shortlisted SKUs | 7 |
| Estimated monthly GMV | ₹3,46,327 |
| Estimated monthly units | 177.6 |
| Blended margin at current vendor costs | 32.9% |
| First order | 150 units, ₹1,87,485 at vendor cost before GST |
| Payment terms | 45 days |

## Investments
- Brand-funded launch marketing: ₹2,50,000
- Launch discount: 10% for the first 30 days, funded by the brand

## Promo calendar
| Event | Start | End |
|---|---|---|
| Listings live | 2026-11-13 | 2026-11-13 |
| Launch week: sponsored listings and sampling | 2026-11-13 | 2026-11-19 |
| Launch-month discount window | 2026-11-13 | 2026-12-12 |
| First sell-through review | 2026-12-13 | 2026-12-13 |

## Commitments and next steps
- Written order confirmation and PO acknowledgement from Highland Paws
- Revisit margin and MOQ at the first sell-through review on 2026-12-13
